description: Ministry of Defence - Extradition Law, No. 8 of 1977, Order Under Section 2
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Extradition Law, No. 08 of 1977. It contains an official order issued by the Minister of Defence that modifies the list of designated Commonwealth countries for extradition purposes. This falls under legal framework modifications and regulatory updates, which is the core characteristic of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions a government official (Ranil Wickremesinghe), it does not focus on government structure changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
